name: desktop-startup-hardening
title: Harden desktop startup failure handling
description: Fix confirmed desktop startup failure modes across macOS and Windows: avoid first-run hangs when the sidecar dies before SQLite migration completes, stop crashing on sidecar spawn failure, preserve correct startup shell gating and error states, restore correct remote/default-server startup behavior, and repair Windows WSL startup config handling.
creator: claude-agent
notes: Confirmed startup review findings: first-run startup can hang forever if sidecar dies before sqlite migration emits done; sidecar spawn failure still crashes startup via expect; startup shell currently relies on a 12s fallback and can hide too early or sit above error UI; desktop can boot against sidecar before persisted defaultServer resolves; Windows WSL startup config is stubbed and never actually enables the WSL path. Fixes should preserve the startup shell UX while adding explicit failure handling, correct readiness semantics, and platform-safe fallbacks.
